verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a log streaming service that exports tenant logs in near real-time to a log analysis service, with configurable content type and format and a payload preview in the Dashboard. This covers the stream/export-to-SIEM part of the story. The evidence says nothing about tamper-evidence or integrity guarantees, and it never states which events are included, so coverage of both authentication and admin activity is unconfirmed. missing for 10: tamper-evident/integrity guarantees, explicit coverage of authentication and admin event types, named SIEM integrations, independent hands-on corroboration.
